body:
Good morning, my friend!

Behind the chapel, past the big trees, there is a quiet grove. I have never shown it to you!

The ground is covered in fallen leaves. Come and find me there, and we'll look at them together.

Follow the path round the chapel.
summary: Find the grove behind the chapel, and sort the fallen leaves.
done: You found the grove and sorted the leaves!

tasks.where: in the grove behind the chapel
